items.headline: Futures Indicate Negative Open Amid Soaring Yields and Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: U.S. equity futures are pointing to a lower open on Thursday, pressured by a significant rise in Treasury yields, surging crude oil prices, and persistent geopolitical concerns. Investors are also digesting strong economic data, which fuels expectations for continued hawkishness from the Federal Reserve. Not financial advice.

items.statContext: Tech and growth stocks face pressure.
Suggests a cautious start to trading.

items.headline: Grail Surges on FDA Panel Backing
items.summary: Grail ($GRAL) surged 11.3% to $120.81 in pre-market trading after an FDA advisory panel endorsed the benefits of the company's Galleri multi-cancer early detection blood test.

items.headline: Wetour Robotics Jumps on Blockchain Focus and AI Expansion
items.summary: Wetour Robotics ($WETO) climbed 51.0% to $2.19, driven by its recognition as a top blockchain-related stock and its recent acquisition of Kiavi, alongside the introduction of AI agents aimed at streamlining the home loan market.

items.headline: Stitch Fix Plummets on Weak Outlook
items.summary: Stitch Fix ($SFIX) plunged 18.4% after the online styling service reported weaker-than-expected fiscal fourth-quarter results and issued a significantly subdued fiscal 2027 revenue outlook.

items.headline: Darden Restaurants Declines on Q1 Revenue Miss
items.summary: Darden Restaurants ($DRI) saw its shares decline over 5% in pre-market trading, as its first-quarter revenue fell short of market estimates.

items.headline: MGM Resorts Down on Acquisition Proposal Withdrawal
items.summary: MGM Resorts International ($MGM) shares fell over 9% in pre-market after Barry Diller's People Inc. withdrew its proposal to acquire the company.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Surge, Fueling Fed Rate Hike Expectations
items.summary: Treasury yields continued their ascent, with the 10-year yield touching 5.11%, the 2-year climbing to 4.897%, and the 30-year rising to 5.438%, their highest levels in years. This jump reinforces market expectations for the Federal Reserve to hike interest rates further, with the CME Group's FedWatch tool indicating a 70.9% likelihood of a hike after its October meeting.

items.headline: Key Economic Data Releases Expected Today
items.summary: Today's economic calendar includes the release of Jobless Claims and Current Account data at 8:30 AM ET, followed by New Home Sales at 10:00 AM ET. Earlier, Germany's IFO Current Assessment and Business Climate for September showed slight declines from forecasts.

items.headline: Costco, Darden, BlackBerry Among Companies Reporting Earnings
items.summary: Several major companies are scheduled to report earnings today. Before market open, TD Synnex Corp ($SNX), BlackBerry ($BB), H.B. Fuller Company ($FUL), and Darden Restaurants ($DRI) will announce results. Costco Wholesale Corp. ($COST) is slated to release its Q4 2026 numbers after the market closes.

items.headline: Crude Oil Prices Climb Amid Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: International crude oil prices are surging, with WTI crude around $93.2 and Brent crude near $99.5, driven by supply risk premiums stemming from ongoing geopolitical tensions between the U.S. and Iran.

items.headline: US-China Trade Talks in Focus
items.summary: Market participants are closely watching developments from talks between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping, following an agreement between top officials to extend a trade truce until January.

items.headline: AI Stocks Show Mixed Pre-market Sentiment
items.summary: While AI-linked semiconductor and infrastructure stocks are generally finding support, some companies like Meta Platforms ($META) are seeing a pre-market pullback (down more than 2%) following the initial momentum from its Muse AI agent launch. Memory stocks are also under pressure due to rising Fed rate-hike expectations.
